findings.description: The Port of San Francisco opened a 5,000-square-foot public plaza, Alioto's Plaza, at Fisherman's Wharf, after an 11,000-square-foot restaurant space there proved too costly to lease.

citation.label: The Registry, “Port of San Francisco Opens Alioto’s Plaza at Fisherman’s Wharf After 11,000 SQFT Restaurant Proved Too Costly to Lease,” 25 September 2026

raw.text: The Port of San Francisco cut the ribbon on a 5,000-square-foot public plaza at Fisherman's Wh[arf]

publish.note: Paywalled after the lede: the visible text gives the plaza's size and that a restaurant space preceded it, but not which building or parcel the plaza physically occupies, so it cannot be placed on a page without guessing. It is also a public plaza rather than a building in the ordinary sense, which REFERENCE.md's place-page rules would need to settle separately even with the full article in hand.

resolution.method: Not resolved: the finding is declined for insufficient evidence, so no parcel is sought by hand.
